{
  "dataset_name": "postcutoff_ro_real_estate_20260503",
  "model_family": "distance_knn",
  "schema_generator": "gpt-5.5-pro",
  "schema_version": "1.0.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "area_sqm_unit_interval",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Living area mapped to a bounded 0-1 coordinate using training-fold observed bounds.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized_similarity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Keeps area comparable with other coordinates so neighbor search is not dominated by raw square-meter scale.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(area_sqm / 180.9, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "rooms_unit_interval",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Room count mapped to a bounded 0-1 coordinate across the observed one-to-five room span.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized_similarity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates comparable room-count geometry for distance-based neighborhood matching.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((rooms - 1.0) / 4.0, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "floor_unit_interval",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Floor value mapped to a bounded 0-1 coordinate covering basement through upper floors.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized_similarity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Stabilizes floor-related distance contributions and helps neighbors align on vertical position.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((floor + 1.0) / 55.0, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "scrape_time_unit_interval",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Scrape timestamp mapped to a bounded 0-1 coordinate using training-fold observed bounds.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "temporal_similarity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Keeps temporally nearby rows closer without letting the timestamp scale overwhelm other distances.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((scraped_at - 5.0) / 2823.0, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "title_unit_interval",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Title numeric field mapped to a bounded 0-1 coordinate using the training-fold observed span.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized_similarity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Adds a bounded coordinate for title magnitude while preventing this field from dominating distance calculations.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((title - 3.0) / 129.0, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "sqm_per_room_unit_interval",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Area per room compressed into a bounded 0-1 spaciousness coordinate.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio_similarity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures layout density so rows with similar space-per-room patterns become closer.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((area_sqm / np.maximum(rooms, 1.0)) / 90.0, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "distance_to_fold_centroid_core",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Unsupervised Euclidean distance from the fold centroid over area, rooms, floor, and scrape time, with each coordinate divided by its fold dispersion.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 6.0],
      "feature_family": "unsupervised_prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a compact typicality axis that helps KNN separate central rows from geometric outliers.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(((area_sqm - 69.77014134275618) / 27.649056814586025) ** 2 + ((rooms - 2.362190812720848) / 0.7621233164365396) ** 2 + ((floor - 22.09540636042403) / 16.897364675063375) ** 2 + ((scraped_at - 1460.5724381625441) / 825.742700847907) ** 2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "distance_to_compact_layout_prototype",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Distance to a generic compact two-room layout prototype using area, rooms, and floor on fold-scaled coordinates.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 7.0],
      "feature_family": "generic_prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Adds a generic prototype-distance axis that improves local geometry around compact dwellings.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(((area_sqm - 45.0) / 27.649056814586025) ** 2 + ((rooms - 2.0) / 0.7621233164365396) ** 2 + ((floor - 8.0) / 16.897364675063375) ** 2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "compact_layout_cluster_flag",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicator for compact one-or-two-room layouts with area at or below 60 square meters.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "cluster_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Forms a crisp local neighborhood for compact layouts that may otherwise be blurred by continuous distances.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((rooms <= 2.0) & (area_sqm <= 60.0), 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "spacious_elevated_layout_cluster_flag",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicator for roomy elevated layouts with at least three rooms, at least 85 square meters, and floor 15 or higher.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "cluster_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates an explicit neighborhood marker for large upper-floor dwellings without allowing any single raw scale to dominate.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((rooms >= 3.0) & (area_sqm >= 85.0) & (floor >= 15.0), 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "title_presentation_semantic_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Numeric assessor score from 0 to 1 using decoded title text or title-code metadata from the training fold; higher values indicate stronger presentation cues such as renovated, furnished, terrace, parking, panoramic, or central wording.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_similarity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Adds a bounded semantic similarity coordinate so listings with similar presentation wording become closer even when physical fields differ.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": false
    },
    {
      "name": "location_amenity_semantic_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Numeric assessor score from 0 to 1 using decoded location text or location-code metadata from the training fold; higher values indicate stronger access, amenity, and centrality signals.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_similarity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Improves neighborhoods by grouping rows with semantically similar areas while using no outcome information.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": false
    }
  ]
}
